Definition: from G435 and G5408; a murderer:--manslayer.
BiblicalUsage: Paul names manslayers among those for whom the law is made, beside murderers of fathers and mothers. The word is the plain name for a man who kills another man.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a manslayer carries no teaching of its own; its place in Paul's list says enough, that taking a life stands among the sins the law was written to restrain.
